title: Items Grow The World
description: Start small, expand by gathering items!
body:
# Items Grow The World

[⚠️] WARNING: This data pack alters how the game is played significantly, so consider applying this pack by itself or with few others.

-----

### How it works

It is recommended you play with others, as more players means more mining, and more mining means more world!

You start with nothing, like in vanilla, but the world is tiny (8x8 blocks)! Expand your world by gathering resources. After you gather a certain number of blocks, you'll unlock another layer of your world. When you unlock a layer, the cost for the next will be more than the last. There are no boosts or buffs you can get, so you can't expand your world by say 10 blocks at once.

[⚠️] Known Issues

- Exponential item costs are very extreme and will be reduced significantly

-----
## Good luck!
